name: Crack a fetch for an untapped shockland when no Island is up
intent: Crack Flooded Strand, Marsh Flats or Polluted Delta on my precombat main for an untapped shockland carrying Island (blue for Psychic Frog) when no untapped land of mine carries that type, while Swamp is already up, paying 2 life because that colour is actually missing. If Island is up, fetch-untapped-shock-third-color checks Plains. It prefers a shock with Island, then a basic Island, then any basic, so with no such shock in reach it takes a free basic rather than paying for a colour that is up. Only at 8 life or more, because the fetch plus the shock costs 3, and only while a shock with Island is still in my library. With Swamp, Island and Plains all up no fetch play fires: every colour a shock would give is already available, and fetching a basic or holding the fetch is the pilot's call. Breeding Pool counts as an Island shock here; the deck casts no green card, so green is never needed. Limits: a colour counts as up only from an untapped land with its basic land type, so anything else that makes the colour is not seen, and this can pay for a colour it already makes; one play cannot say that any one of several colours is missing, hence one play per colour; and a library count cannot tell which fetch gets cracked, which is why the pick falls back to basics.
